file_names = [f.split("/")[-1] for f in files]

# Create directories and move files
for f in file_names:
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    parts = f.split("__")
    date = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]  # e.g., "slides.ppt"
    
    # Split rest into file_name and extension
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
    
    # Create directory for file_name
    dir_path = base_dir + file_name + "/"
    create_resp = apis.file_system.create_directory(
        access_token=access_token,
        directory_path=dir_path,
        recursive=True
    )
    print(f"Created dir {dir_path}: {create_resp}")
    
    # Move file to new location
    source_path = base_dir + f
    dest_path = dir_path + date + "." + ext
    move_resp = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=access_token,
        source_file_path=source_path,
        destination_file_path=dest_path
    )
    print(f"Moved {source_path} -> {dest_path}: {move_resp}")
